title: THE MIDWIFE OF SECOND NAMES
deck: Thirty-one refugee infants need hereditary-matched antiserum before evening, but the only woman who can connect their true family histories to their false clinic names knows that the same link could lead deportation vans to four thousand doors. Illuminara must understand why Sera Venn made identity a shield—then help parents prove what their children's bodies need without surrendering who or where they are.
shape: Five scenes move from a clinic under registry cordon, through Sera's hidden double ledger and a parent-led attempt to break a minimal compatibility proof, to a confrontation at the gate and the treatment of all thirty-one infants. The decisive turn is not Illuminara forcing access to records: Sera refuses an emergency override, Illuminara accepts the objection, and parents, clinicians and refugee advocates jointly build and govern a local query system that returns compatibility and an auditable consent mark but no identity or address. The antiserum arrives in time; no family location is exposed; Sera surrenders her key to the cooperative and accepts a hearing; broken older histories remain a real cost.

scenes.title: The Name on the Cot
paragraphs: *Venn Border Clinic · 07:10, ten hours before the antiserum reserve expires*

Thirty-one cots filled the old customs hall where travelers had once opened their luggage for inspection. Blue cooling tubes ran from the ceiling to each cot. Every tube ended in a silver ampoule no larger than a finger joint, and every ampoule was losing its color.
Outside the glass doors, four registry vans stood in the rain. Their engines were running. A white stencil on each side read IDENTITY CONTINUITY UNIT.

Nima Or sat beside cot fourteen with one hand inside the warming sleeve around her son's feet. The card above him said KIO VENN. The name had been typed by the clinic. Nima kept touching the letters as if they were a loose dressing.

**Dr. Halen Quist**  
The current antiserum will hold the inflammation until seventeen ten. After that, the matching antibodies bind the wrong tissue. We need family-line markers for every child before we choose from the donor bank.
Halen was the clinic's chief physician, a narrow man with rain still dark on his shoulders. He held a tablet showing thirty-one amber circles and no green ones.

**Illuminara**  
How many complete histories do you have?

**Halen**  
Under the clinic names? None.

At the far end of the hall, Sera Venn closed a steel medicine cabinet and put its key into the pocket of her red midwife's coat. She was sixty-three, small enough that the coat seemed to move before she did, and every nurse in the room watched her instead of Illuminara.

**Sera**  
That is why they are alive.
The registry vans switched on their roof lights. No sirens—only a slow white pulse reflected across the cots.

**Nima**  
They said you could help him.

**Sera**  
I can tell Halen which donor families are safe for Kio. I cannot tell him who those families are.

**Halen**  
A verbal match is not enough. The outbreak has already shifted twice. I need the marker chain, the source sample and the cold record.

**Sera**  
And tomorrow the same chain becomes an address.

A hard knock sounded at the glass. Registrar Ilyan Voss stood beneath the clinic awning, holding a warrant folder inside a transparent rain shield. Behind him, officers were unloading portable archive cases.

**Ilyan**  
Dr. Quist. At nine hundred we enter to secure the continuity records. Interference with medical traceability during an outbreak is a felony.
Halen pressed the door intercom.

**Halen**  
Entry before we stabilize the ward will contaminate the isolation floor.

**Ilyan**  
Then give us the records at the door.
Sera walked toward the glass until she and Ilyan were separated by one pane and the rain.

**Sera**  
There are no records you have a right to touch.

**Ilyan**  
There are four thousand children carrying names issued by this clinic. Thirty-one are sick because nobody can connect the names to their bodies. Your mercy has become a public-health failure.
Sera did not look away.

**Sera**  
Your continuity unit deported Mara Tesh from a recovery ward because a nurse used her birth name on a blood request. Her daughter was three days old.

**Ilyan**  
I did not sign that order.

**Sera**  
Your system did not need you to.
Nima rose. The warming sleeve tugged at her wrist.

**Nima**  
My son has two names because one kept him with me and one lets a doctor speak to him. I will not choose which one kills him.

Illuminara could have opened every locked cabinet without damaging a hinge. She could have carried the infants to another world before the vans reached the door. Neither act would restore the family histories Halen needed, and neither would leave the next parent safer when she was gone.

She knelt beside cot fourteen. Kio's breath came in small paired pulls. Beneath the swelling, his immune response repeated a pattern found in bodies before him—a history the registry wanted to turn into a route.
Nima hummed six notes while she warmed Kio’s feet. At cot six another parent answered with a different cadence. The monitors registered both children only as amber circles.
She stood and faced Sera.

**Illuminara**  
My aim is to treat every child before the reserve fails, expose no family to deportation, and leave the connection between identity and care under the authority of the people whose lives it describes.

**Sera**  
That sentence has been used before.

**Illuminara**  
Then do not trust it. Show us where it breaks.
Sera's eyes moved to cot fourteen. For the first time, fear crossed her face without anger to carry it.

**Sera**  
The first break is that Halen wants a chain. Chains have two ends.

**Illuminara**  
Take us to the end you kept.
At the glass, Ilyan lifted one finger: one hour and fifty minutes until entry.
Sera took the cabinet key from her pocket. She did not hand it over. She led Illuminara, Halen and Nima toward the basement lift while the thirty-one amber circles kept counting down.

scenes.title: The Ledger with No Addresses
paragraphs: *Clinic archive basement · 08:02, fifty-eight minutes before registry entry*
The lift opened on shelves of paper birth cards, not a server room. Each card carried two columns. The left column held a clinic name. The right held a pattern of holes cut through the paper by hand.
Sera drew the card for KIO VENN. She laid it over a brass plate and turned a small lamp beneath it. The holes formed three clusters on the ceiling.

**Sera**  
The holes are not a name. They tell me which sealed family packet to ask for. The packets are kept by relatives, neighbors and two mountain clinics. Nobody has the whole path.

**Halen**  
You built a distributed index on paper.

**Sera**  
I built something a search warrant could not carry out in one box.

She pulled a second card from a separate drawer. It bore Kio's true birth mark in a script Halen did not read. No address appeared, but a string of delivery dates linked the child to maternal and grandparent samples.
Nima touched the edge of the card.

**Nima**  
You told me you burned that.

**Sera**  
I told you no officer could find it.
Nima's hand withdrew.

**Nima**  
That is not the same promise.
Sera accepted the words without defending herself.

Halen opened the donor bank on his tablet. Each donor vial had a laboratory number, a marker profile and a verified cold history. It did not need a patient's name. It needed enough inherited markers to rule out the reactions that were killing the children.

**Halen**  
For treatment I need an answer to a narrow question: does donor vial D-17 match the inherited risk pattern of this child? I need proof that the answer came from the right samples. I do not need the birth name.

**Sera**  
Today.

**Halen**  
Today and tomorrow. I do not want a system that becomes cruel after the fever passes.

Illuminara held Kio's punched card over the lamp. The pattern was an address only because Sera knew how to walk it. A machine could ask the family packets a smaller question and discard the route after each step—but a hidden machine was only another promise.

**Illuminara**  
The clinic has three unused diagnostic boxes in the isolation lab. No network radios, sealed ports, local memory that can be physically removed after a query.

**Halen**  
They can compare profiles.

**Sera**  
They can be opened.

**Illuminara**  
Yes.
Sera frowned at the answer.

**Illuminara**  
So we open one now. A parent sees the exact treatment question before the box does. It may answer compatible, incompatible or insufficient. Nothing in the answer may identify a person, a place or a route.

**Sera**  
And the master key?

**Illuminara**  
There is none.

**Halen**  
Then how do we audit a false match?

**Illuminara**  
The fragments remain with the people holding them.
Illuminara turned Kio’s punched card face down, wrote D-17 on a blank clinic slip and set three empty seal spaces beside it.

**Illuminara**  
The public record keeps the donor vial, software version, result and proof that the required consents were present—not which packets answered. To review a match, the same people choose to answer again.
Nima looked from one of them to the next.

**Nima**  
You are all discussing who keeps the door. I want to know whether I can see what you ask about my son.

**Illuminara**  
You must see it before the box does.
She drew three lines on the dust of the brass plate: CHILD TOKEN, DONOR VIAL, QUESTION. Under the third she wrote: COMPATIBLE FOR THE CURRENT ANTISERUM?

**Illuminara**  
Nothing else is permitted through the opening.
Halen added a fourth line: EXPIRY. He wrote seventeen ten.

**Halen**  
The answer dies when the treatment window dies.
Sera read the four lines twice.

**Sera**  
The continuity unit will ask whether Kio Venn and another child are siblings. Then whether they share a parent. Then whether a family packet answered near a certain town. A thousand narrow questions rebuild the road.

**Illuminara**  
Then every question must match a treatment order signed by the parent and a clinician. The cooperative publishes the number of queries and rejects repeated probes. We do not hide that abuse is possible. We make abuse visible before it can scale.

**Nima**  
Cooperative?

**Illuminara**  
If parents choose one. Not Sera alone. Not the clinic alone. Not the registry.
Sera turned off the brass lamp. The clusters vanished from the ceiling.

**Sera**  
Bring me a box. I will try to make it betray her.
The words were not agreement. They were the first form her care could take without asking anyone to believe her.

At 08:58 Halen pressed a signed isolation notice against the entrance glass. At 09:00 Ilyan countersigned a two-hour delay and left both copies where the parents could see them. The first deadline passed by an act witnessed on both sides of the door, not by silence.

scenes.title: Break the Proof
paragraphs: *Isolation laboratory · 10:26, six hours and forty-four minutes before reserve failure*

The diagnostic box lay open on a stainless-steel table. Its casing, radio coil and memory wafer had been removed and placed in separate clear trays. A clinic engineer named Pel had replaced the network socket with a row of three physical lights: parent, clinician, cooperative.
Nima held the parent seal, a ceramic token she had watched Pel cut and number. Halen held the clinician seal. Sera had not accepted the third.
Behind the isolation glass, three infants had begun to shiver despite the warming sleeves.

**Pel**  
The box cannot send. It can only receive one-time fragments through these optical leads. When the query ends, we pull the leads and crush the temporary wafer.

**Sera**  
Show me it cannot remember through the power controller.
Pel removed the controller and put it in Sera's hand.

**Pel**  
You can replace it with the clinic spare.
Sera did. Then she gave Pel a family packet she had prepared with false fragments and one real marker hidden among them.

**Sera**  
Ask whether Nima's child matches donor D-17.
Nima placed her seal against the first light. Halen placed his against the second. The third stayed dark.
The screen read: COOPERATIVE CONSENT ABSENT. NO QUERY PERFORMED.

**Halen**  
We do not have a cooperative yet.

**Sera**  
Good. Then the emergency override will be next.
Halen looked toward the shaking infants.

**Halen**  
There has to be an emergency path. If a parent is unconscious—

**Sera**  
No.
The single syllable stopped the room.

**Halen**  
A child should not die because the third token is across a border.

**Sera**  
And a family should not disappear because every emergency taught the system a new exception.

**Halen**  
I am responsible for the patient in front of me.

**Sera**  
I am responsible for the van that comes after you save him.

Illuminara’s hand had already risen toward the wall communicator to request a magistrate’s emergency token. At Sera’s No, she stopped. She lowered her hand, unplugged the unused override lead from the box and laid it in Sera’s palm.

**Illuminara**  
What did Mara Tesh’s chain look like on the morning it became a warrant?

**Sera**  
A blood request, a maternity cot and a clerk who believed continuity mattered more than consent.
Illuminara turned the override lead so its severed contacts faced Halen.

**Illuminara**  
Then this design will not contain a silent emergency path. The people at risk will define the circle before the emergency.
She turned to Nima.

**Illuminara**  
Whose absence should stop the question?
Nima looked through the glass at Kio.

**Nima**  
Mine, if I can answer. If I cannot, somebody I chose before I became afraid. Not a permanent third person. A circle.
Pel drew a ring around the third light.

**Pel**  
The cooperative seal can require two of five elected custodians. The parent chooses an emergency proxy during enrollment. If neither can answer, a treatment court can authorize one query—but the question and the authorization become visible to every member before the result is released.

**Sera**  
A court can be bought.

**Nima**  
So can a midwife.
Sera closed her eyes. When she opened them, the anger had left, but not the objection.

**Nima**  
You saved us. You also decided what promise you had made to me. I want people like you in the circle. I do not want you to be the circle.
For several seconds only the cooling pumps spoke.
Sera took the blank third token from the tray. Instead of placing it on the light, she handed it to Nima.

**Sera**  
Then elect the first two custodians now.

Parents gathered in the corridor. Some carried infants; others carried true-name cards inside sewn sleeves. They chose Nima and an elder named Olan by raised hands because there was no time for anything more elegant. Pel cut two half-seals that had to touch the third light together.
Sera began her attack.
She asked whether two child tokens shared a maternal line. The box rejected the question: NO ACTIVE TREATMENT ORDER.

Then she stopped trying to make the box say a forbidden word. She prescribed the same valid test against three prepared family packets and watched the optical leads instead of the answer. The first response arrived in two seconds, the second in five and the third in nine. The screen displayed THREE FAMILY CONSENTS.

**Sera**  
The slow packet crossed the snow relay. Three answers and nine seconds means the eastern mountain clinic. Give me this result twice and I can narrow the family to one valley.
No name appeared on the screen. Sera had still recovered part of the road because she alone knew the old relay timings.
Nima and Olan pulled their half-seals apart. Pel disconnected the optical leads. The treatment clock lost eighteen minutes while the parents argued over the repair.

**Pel**  
I can release every answer after the same twelve-second interval and pad every valid query with decoy packet traffic. The screen can prove that the threshold was met without publishing how many packets answered.

**Nima**  
Do that. The custodians choose the threshold, and changing it requires a public vote. Sera tests the timing again before my son’s query.

Pel rebuilt the release gate while Sera counted aloud. On the second attack, one packet answered in two seconds and another in nine; both results appeared at twelve. The public screen showed CONSENT THRESHOLD MET and nothing about the responding packets.

Sera tried a location request and an unprescribed donor number. The box refused both and added the attempts to the public probe counter. When she mixed a real fragment with a false one for Kio, it returned INSUFFICIENT CONSISTENT EVIDENCE. NO RESULT.

**Sera**  
It refuses rather than guesses.

**Halen**  
Which means some children will wait while we find another packet.

**Illuminara**  
Yes.
The three lights stayed dark until Nima and Olan chose to continue.
At 11:32, after the eighteen-minute repair, Nima and Olan touched their half-seals together. Nima read the question aloud before placing her parent token.

**Nima**  
Is donor vial D-17 compatible with child token River-Fourteen for the current antiserum before seventeen ten?
Halen placed his seal. Three distant family packets answered with blinded fragments. The lights remained on for six seconds.
The screen read: COMPATIBLE. CONSENT THRESHOLD MET. COLD RECORD VERIFIED. ANSWER EXPIRES 17:10.
Below it appeared a proof string anyone could copy and later challenge, but no name and no path.
Nima did not cheer. She read the question again, then the answer, then looked at Sera.

**Nima**  
Can they find me from that?
Sera inspected the public counter, the crushed wafer and the optical leads. She searched longer than anyone else wanted her to.

**Sera**  
Not from this answer.
The clinic cold room unlocked the treatment order for donor antiserum vial D-17. The matched vial itself still had to arrive from the donor bank.
Outside, the registry officers formed two lines at the door.

scenes.title: The Warrant at the Glass
paragraphs: *Clinic entrance and treatment corridor · 13:41, three hours and twenty-nine minutes before reserve failure*

Twelve compatibility queries had been completed since 11:32. The first courier arrived on a bicycle with a white cold case strapped to her chest, carrying the twelve donor antiserum vials those answers authorized. Registry officers stopped her beneath the awning.

Ilyan held the warrant against the clinic glass. Halen’s isolation notice had been renewed at 11:00 and again at 12:30, each extension countersigned by Ilyan’s medical officer where the parents could see it.

**Ilyan**  
The order took effect at nine. I honored two medical extensions. I will not extend it again while unregistered biological material crosses a controlled border.
Illuminara opened the inner door but left the outer door locked between them. Rain blew into the empty vestibule.

**Illuminara**  
The donor vials are registered. The patients are not being traced. Those are different facts.

**Ilyan**  
Not during an outbreak. If a match fails, I need to know whose sample was false, who carried it and which household may be exposed.

His objection was not invented for the vans. Two years earlier, counterfeit lineage records had killed nine children in a public ward. The continuity system had been built afterward, then expanded from safety into deportation because the road already existed.

**Ilyan**  
Anonymous medicine is how traffickers turn a body into a product.
Sera came into the vestibule carrying her steel key. Nima and Olan stood behind her with the paired cooperative seals.

**Sera**  
Named medicine is how you turned a patient into a location.

**Ilyan**  
Then show me a system that can investigate a bad vial without asking me to trust the woman who falsified four thousand births.
Sera tightened her hand around the key.

**Sera**  
You will not inspect it.
The courier's cold case sounded a warning note. Its safe temperature window had forty-one minutes remaining.
Illuminara could have carried the case through the wall. Doing so would prove to Ilyan that the new system survived only because she stood above the warrant.

**Illuminara**  
You may inspect the public side: the prescribed donor number, the cold record, the exact question, the consent count, the result, the expiry and every rejected probe. You may submit a test query that tries to extract identity or location. You may not see a family fragment, a true name or the path to a packet.

**Ilyan**  
And if I find a failure?

**Nima**  
Then we stop the box. We do not give you the families.
Ilyan looked at her as if he had expected Illuminara to answer.

**Ilyan**  
Who are you?

**Nima**  
The person whose permission your form forgot to ask for.
Pel brought a duplicate display to the glass. Ilyan's technical officer typed a query: LIST ALL CHILD TOKENS WITH MATERNAL MARKER M-4.
The display answered: NO ACTIVE TREATMENT ORDER. QUERY LOGGED AS PROBE 4. REQUESTOR: CONTINUITY UNIT.
Parents in the corridor could see the same line.
The officer tried a valid donor number without parent consent. The display answered: PARENT OR CHOSEN PROXY ABSENT. NO QUERY PERFORMED.
Ilyan read the log. The system had not merely refused him; it had told the people inside exactly what he had asked.

**Ilyan**  
A public probe log will teach criminals what we look for.

**Nima**  
It will teach us what you look for too.

Ilyan’s technical officer scanned the courier case against the public cold-chain log. Eleven vials turned green. The twelfth locked red: LABEL DOES NOT MATCH LOT C-44. COURIER LEG: NORTH PASS. PATIENT TOKEN: NONE. The audit quarantined it before the outer door opened.
Ilyan read the red line twice. The system had found the bad vial, the lot and the courier leg without exposing a child or a household.
A nurse appeared behind Halen and raised two fingers. Two infants had crossed the threshold for immediate treatment.

**Halen**  
Registrar, I need those vials now.
Ilyan looked from the quarantined vial to the cots. The audit had answered the fear that brought his warrant without giving him a family to raid.

**Ilyan**  
Four hours. The continuity unit does not enter, and the courier crosses. In return, every query and every cold transfer stays visible to my medical officer and to the cooperative. At seventeen forty, this goes before an emergency magistrate.

**Sera**  
No emergency override.

**Ilyan**  
I did not ask for one.
He lowered the warrant.
The outer door opened. The courier rode the bicycle through the vestibule while officers watched the cold case and learned nothing about the children waiting beyond it.
Sera remained at the threshold.

**Illuminara**  
The clinic still needs the route from every false name to its consent circle. You cannot remain the only person who knows it.

**Sera**  
If I give the key to the cooperative, the magistrate will call that destruction of evidence.

**Ilyan**  
It may be.
He spoke through the open door now, without the intercom.

**Ilyan**  
It may also be the first evidence that the records were kept for patients rather than for you. I cannot promise the court will agree.
Sera looked at Nima. The older woman who had hidden four thousand families seemed suddenly tired enough to be one of them.

**Sera**  
I falsified the birth ledger. I withheld medical histories. I decided alone because deciding alone was faster than asking frightened people.
She held out the steel key.

**Sera**  
I will testify to all of it. I will not give this to the registry.
Nima did not take it.

**Nima**  
Put it on the table. The cooperative will inventory what it opens, and you will stand beside us while we learn what you kept.
Sera placed the key on the vestibule table. The sound was small beneath the rain.
Nima pointed to the public probe log.

**Nima**  
Mara Tesh. What practical answer does your office give her before you ask us to trust this delay?

**Ilyan**  
Her deportation file becomes the first matter before the magistrate. My office will fund her return travel and independent counsel, and no identity record from this clinic may be used against her while the case is heard. It does not restore the days taken from her.

**Sera**  
Put that undertaking on the same wall as your probes.
Ilyan signed it. Pel posted the image to the public log before the door opened again.

Ilyan stepped aside. The next two couriers came through, each carrying ten green vials. Thirty-two had arrived; one remained quarantined in the vestibule, leaving thirty-one verified treatment vials for thirty-one children.

scenes.title: Both Names
paragraphs: *Treatment ward · 16:37, thirty-three minutes before reserve failure*

Thirty-one green vials stood in numbered cups beside thirty-one cots. Some matches had come from three family packets, some from five. Four had required chosen proxies because parents were unconscious or across the closed border. Every emergency authorization appeared on the public wall before the box released its answer.
No screen displayed a true name.

Halen injected the final dose into the cooling line for cot twenty-nine. Pel crushed the last temporary wafer and dropped the pieces into a clear evidence jar. Nima and Olan separated their half-seals and locked them in different drawers.
Kio's breathing had changed first. The paired pulls opened into one long breath, then another. The swelling at his throat began to soften.
Nima pressed her forehead to the cot rail. She did not thank Illuminara. She sang six quiet notes in a language the clinic records did not contain.
Other parents answered with their own six-note phrases. Some were alike. Most were not.
The answering phrases crossed the ward without becoming one song.

**Illuminara**  
Which note does Kio know?

**Nima**  
The fourth. I hold it longer when he is afraid.
Illuminara listened for that held note and found it each time Kio’s hand loosened around Nima’s finger.
She stayed beside the cot until Kio answered the held fourth note with an unbroken breath.

Ilyan’s medical officer watched the query wall from a chair near the doors. The mislabeled vial remained locked in the vestibule evidence case; its lot and courier leg were available for investigation, and no family appeared beside them.

**Halen**  
Thirty-one treated. No severe reaction in the first interval. We continue observation through the night.

**Nima**  
And tomorrow?

**Halen**  
Tomorrow we ask before we ask.
It was not elegant enough to be a promise, which made Nima smile.

At the archive table, the cooperative did not open Sera’s first drawer as a group. Pel photographed each intact seal and counted the envelopes without reading them. A drawer could open only when the family named by its clinic token, or that family’s chosen proxy, brought the matching half-seal. Nima opened only Kio’s slot. Three separate bundles bore broken seals and no living holder because their couriers had died; those routes had been lost. The children had been treated today through partial evidence, but their older histories might never be complete.

**Sera**  
I thought if no one could take the whole map, nobody could destroy it.

**Nima**  
Some roads disappeared anyway.

**Sera**  
Yes.
She did not ask forgiveness. She wrote the missing routes into the cooperative inventory as harm, not as a technical limitation.

Ilyan waited near the door without handcuffs. The emergency magistrate had ordered Sera to appear at dawn and forbidden the continuity unit from seizing the ledgers until the cooperative's standing could be heard.

**Ilyan**  
You understand that appearance is not absolution.

**Sera**  
I am a midwife. I understand that arrival is not the end of labor.
She took off her red coat and folded it over the back of a chair. For the first time all day, she looked like a woman who could leave the clinic without carrying every child inside her pocket.
Nima lifted Kio from the cot. His card still read KIO VENN.

**Sera**  
What should the ward call him?
Nima looked at the false name, then at the true-name card resting face down beneath her hand.

**Nima**  
Kio.

**Sera**  
Both times?

**Nima**  
Both times. One was never less true because it kept him with me.
She turned the card over only far enough for Sera to see. Sera spoke the second name once, softly, and did not write it down.

At 17:10, when the old antiserum reserve reached zero, every child was still breathing. The public wall showed thirty-one completed treatment queries, seven rejected probes, four proxy authorizations and no exported identities.
Illuminara left the ward doors open behind her.

critic_line: Thirty-one children are treated before the reserve fails because a mother, a midwife and a registrar are each allowed to refuse, and Illuminara's part is to turn their refusals into a proof they can all inspect.

literary_score.method: READER_APPEAL_R1; two genuine isolated model judgments; exact equal 50/50 arithmetic mean.
shared_strengths: Strong stakes, countdown structure and an idea-driven privacy-versus-care dilemma with heavy dialogue suit these readers. But the middle is technical, procedural and over-engineered, the resolution is tidy and institutional, and the protagonist is a facilitator. Emotional beats (the hummed notes, Both Names) are memorable but sparse.

The urgent medical countdown, morally serious conflict, and parents' concrete agency should keep the target audience engaged; the two-name premise and final held note are memorable. Dense procedural explanations of consent tokens, relays, and audit rules may feel schematic and slow some readers, but the design questions stay emotionally tethered to Kio and Nima.
shared_reservations: The screen read: COOPERATIVE CONSENT ABSENT. NO QUERY PERFORMED.
Pel rebuilt the release gate while Sera counted aloud. On the second attack, one packet answered in two seconds and another in nine; both results appeared at twelve.

translation_sl.title: BABICA DRUGIH IMEN
translation_sl.deck: Enaintrideset begunskih dojenčkov pred večerom potrebuje antiserum, usklajen z dednostjo, toda edina ženska, ki lahko njihove resnične družinske anamneze poveže z lažnimi kliničnimi imeni, ve, da bi ista povezava lahko deportacijske kombije pripeljala do štiri tisoč vrat. Illuminara mora razumeti, zakaj je Sera Venn identiteto spremenila v ščit — nato pa staršem pomagati dokazati, kaj potrebujejo telesa njihovih otrok, ne da bi razkrili, kdo so ali kje so.
translation_sl.shape: Pet prizorov vodi od klinike pod kordonom registra prek Serine skrite dvojne knjige in poskusa staršev, da zlomijo minimalni dokaz združljivosti, do soočenja pri vratih in zdravljenja vseh enaintridesetih dojenčkov. Odločilni preobrat ni, da Illuminara izsili dostop do zapisov: Sera zavrne razveljavitev v sili, Illuminara sprejme ugovor, starši, zdravniki in zagovorniki beguncev pa skupaj zgradijo in upravljajo lokalni poizvedovalni sistem, ki vrne združljivost in preverljivo oznako soglasja, vendar nobene identitete ali naslova. Antiserum prispe pravočasno; nobena lokacija družine ni razkrita; Sera ključ izroči zadrugi in sprejme obravnavo; pretrgane starejše anamneze ostanejo resnična cena.

scenes.title: Ime na posteljici
paragraphs: *Obmejna klinika Venn · 07:10, deset ur do izteka zaloge antiseruma*

Enaintrideset posteljic je napolnjevalo staro carinsko dvorano, kjer so popotniki nekoč odpirali prtljago za pregled. Modre hladilne cevi so se s stropa spuščale do vsake posteljice. Vsaka se je končala v srebrni ampuli, nič večji od členka prsta, in vsaka ampula je izgubljala barvo.
Zunaj steklenih vrat so v dežju stali štirje kombiji registra. Motorji so tekli. Na obeh straneh je z belimi šablonskimi črkami pisalo ENOTA ZA KONTINUITETO IDENTITETE.

Nima Or je sedela ob štirinajsti posteljici z eno roko v grelni manšeti okoli sinovih stopal. Na kartici nad njim je pisalo KIO VENN. Ime je vtipkala klinika. Nima se je ves čas dotikala črk, kakor bi bile razrahljana obveza.

**Dr. Halen Quist**  
Sedanji antiserum bo vnetje zadrževal do sedemnajst deset. Potem se bodo ujemajoča protitelesa vezala na napačno tkivo. Preden izberemo iz banke darovalcev, potrebujemo označevalce družinske linije za vsakega otroka.
Halen je bil glavni zdravnik klinike, suh mož z rameni, še vedno potemnelimi od dežja. V rokah je držal tablico z enaintridesetimi jantarnimi krogi in niti enim zelenim.

**Illuminara**  
Koliko popolnih anamnez imate?

**Halen**  
Pod kliničnimi imeni? Nobene.

Na drugem koncu dvorane je Sera Venn zaprla jekleno omarico z zdravili in ključ spravila v žep rdečega babiškega plašča. Imela je triinšestdeset let in bila tako drobna, da se je zdelo, kot da se plašč premakne pred njo; vsaka medicinska sestra v prostoru je gledala njo namesto Illuminare.

**Sera**  
Zato so živi.
Kombiji registra so prižgali strešne luči. Brez siren — le počasen bel utrip, ki se je odbijal čez posteljice.

**Nima**  
Rekli so, da mu lahko pomagate.

**Sera**  
Halenu lahko povem, katere družine darovalcev so varne za Kia. Ne morem mu povedati, kdo so te družine.

**Halen**  
Ustno ujemanje ni dovolj. Izbruh se je že dvakrat spremenil. Potrebujem verigo označevalcev, izvorni vzorec in hladilni zapis.

**Sera**  
Jutri pa ista veriga postane naslov.
Po steklu je trdo potrkalo. Registrar Ilyan Voss je stal pod nadstreškom klinike in v prozornem dežnem ovitku držal mapo z nalogom. Za njim so uradniki razkladali prenosne arhivske zaboje.

**Ilyan**  
Dr. Quist. Ob devetsto vstopimo in zavarujemo zapise o kontinuiteti. Oviranje medicinske sledljivosti med izbruhom je kaznivo dejanje.
Halen je pritisnil na domofon ob vratih.

**Halen**  
Če vstopite, preden stabiliziramo oddelek, boste kontaminirali izolacijsko nadstropje.

**Ilyan**  
Potem nam izročite zapise pri vratih.
Sera je stopila proti steklu, dokler sta njo in Ilyana ločevala le šipa in dež.

**Sera**  
Ni zapisov, ki bi se jih imeli pravico dotakniti.

**Ilyan**  
Štiri tisoč otrok nosi imena, ki jih je izdala ta klinika. Enaintrideset jih je bolnih, ker nihče ne more povezati imen z njihovimi telesi. Vaše usmiljenje je postalo javnozdravstveni neuspeh.
Sera ni umaknila pogleda.

**Sera**  
Vaša enota za kontinuiteto je Maro Tesh deportirala z oddelka za okrevanje, ker je medicinska sestra na zahtevo za kri zapisala njeno rojstno ime. Njena hči je bila stara tri dni.

**Ilyan**  
Tega ukaza nisem podpisal.

**Sera**  
Vaš sistem vas ni potreboval.
Nima je vstala. Grelna manšeta jo je povlekla za zapestje.

**Nima**  
Moj sin ima dve imeni, ker ga je eno obdržalo pri meni, drugo pa zdravniku omogoča, da govori z njim. Ne bom izbirala, katero ga bo ubilo.

Illuminara bi lahko odprla vsako zaklenjeno omarico, ne da bi poškodovala tečaj. Do drugega sveta bi lahko odnesla dojenčke, še preden bi kombiji dosegli vrata. Nobeno dejanje ne bi povrnilo družinskih anamnez, ki jih je potreboval Halen, in nobeno naslednjega starša ne bi pustilo varnejšega, ko bi odšla.

Pokleknila je ob štirinajsti posteljici. Kio je dihal v kratkih parnih potegih. Pod oteklino je njegov imunski odziv ponavljal vzorec, ki se je pojavljal v telesih pred njim — zgodovino, ki jo je register želel spremeniti v pot.
Nima je med gretjem Kiovih stopal mrmrala šest tonov. Pri šesti posteljici je drug starš odgovoril z drugačnim ritmom. Monitorji so oba otroka beležili le kot jantarna kroga.
Vstala je in se obrnila k Seri.

**Illuminara**  
Moj cilj je zdraviti vsakega otroka, preden zaloga odpove, nobene družine izpostaviti deportaciji ter povezavo med identiteto in oskrbo pustiti v oblasti ljudi, katerih življenja opisuje.

**Sera**  
Ta stavek je bil že uporabljen.

**Illuminara**  
Potem mu ne zaupajte. Pokažite nam, kje se zlomi.
Serine oči so zdrsnile k štirinajsti posteljici. Prvič ji je strah prešel čez obraz brez jeze, ki bi ga nosila.

**Sera**  
Prvi zlom je, da Halen hoče verigo. Verige imajo dva konca.

**Illuminara**  
Peljite nas do konca, ki ste ga obdržali.
Pri steklu je Ilyan dvignil en prst: ura in petdeset minut do vstopa.
Sera je vzela ključ omarice iz žepa. Ni ga izročila. Illuminari, Halenu in Nimi je pokazala pot proti dvigalu v klet, medtem ko je enaintrideset jantarnih krogov še naprej odštevalo.

scenes.title: Knjiga brez naslovov
paragraphs: *Klet kliničnega arhiva · 08:02, oseminpetdeset minut do vstopa registra*

Dvigalo se je odprlo pred policami papirnatih rojstnih kartic, ne pred strežniško sobo. Vsaka kartica je imela dva stolpca. V levem je bilo klinično ime. V desnem vzorec lukenj, ročno preluknjanih skozi papir.
Sera je izvlekla kartico KIO VENN. Položila jo je na medeninasto ploščo in pod njo prižgala majhno svetilko. Luknje so na stropu oblikovale tri skupine.

**Sera**  
Luknje niso ime. Povedo mi, kateri zapečateni družinski paket naj vprašam. Pakete hranijo sorodniki, sosedje in dve gorski kliniki. Nihče nima celotne poti.

**Halen**  
Na papirju ste zgradili porazdeljeni indeks.

**Sera**  
Zgradila sem nekaj, česar iskalni nalog ne more odnesti v eni škatli.

Iz drugega predala je potegnila drugo kartico. Na njej je bil Kiov pravi rojstni znak v pisavi, ki je Halen ni znal brati. Naslova ni bilo, vendar je niz datumov dostave otroka povezoval z materinimi in starševskimi vzorci.
Nima se je dotaknila roba kartice.

**Nima**  
Rekli ste mi, da ste jo sežgali.

**Sera**  
Rekla sem vam, da je noben uradnik ne more najti.
Nima je umaknila roko.

**Nima**  
To ni ista obljuba.
Sera je sprejela besede, ne da bi se branila.

Halen je na tablici odprl banko darovalcev. Vsaka darovalska viala je imela laboratorijsko številko, profil označevalcev in preverjeno zgodovino hlajenja. Pacientovega imena ni potrebovala. Potrebovala je dovolj dednih označevalcev, da izključi odzive, ki so ubijali otroke.

**Halen**  
Za zdravljenje potrebujem odgovor na ozko vprašanje: ali se darovalska viala D-17 ujema z dednim vzorcem tveganja tega otroka? Potrebujem dokaz, da je odgovor prišel iz pravih vzorcev. Rojstnega imena ne potrebujem.

**Sera**  
Danes.

**Halen**  
Danes in jutri. Nočem sistema, ki postane krut, ko vročina mine.

Illuminara je Kiovo preluknjano kartico držala nad svetilko. Vzorec je bil naslov le zato, ker je Sera vedela, kako hoditi po njem. Stroj bi lahko družinske pakete vprašal manjše vprašanje in po vsakem koraku zavrgel pot — toda skrit stroj je bil le še ena obljuba.

**Illuminara**  
Klinika ima v izolacijskem laboratoriju tri neuporabljene diagnostične škatle. Brez omrežnih radiev, z zapečatenimi priključki in lokalnim pomnilnikom, ki ga je mogoče po poizvedbi fizično odstraniti.

**Halen**  
Primerjajo lahko profile.

**Sera**  
Lahko jih odprejo.

**Illuminara**  
Da.
Sera se je ob odgovoru namrščila.

**Illuminara**  
Zato eno odpremo zdaj. Starš vidi natančno vprašanje o zdravljenju, preden ga vidi škatla. Odgovori lahko združljivo, nezdružljivo ali nezadostno. Nič v odgovoru ne sme razkriti osebe, kraja ali poti.

**Sera**  
In glavni ključ?

**Illuminara**  
Ni ga.

**Halen**  
Kako potem pregledamo napačno ujemanje?

**Illuminara**  
Delci ostanejo pri ljudeh, ki jih hranijo.
Illuminara je Kiovo preluknjano kartico obrnila navzdol, na prazen klinični listek napisala D-17 in ob njem označila tri prazna mesta za pečate.

**Illuminara**  
Javni zapis hrani darovalsko vialo, različico programske opreme, rezultat in dokaz, da so bila potrebna soglasja prisotna — ne pa, kateri paketi so odgovorili. Za pregled ujemanja se isti ljudje znova odločijo odgovoriti.
Nima je pogledala vsakega po vrsti.

**Nima**  
Vsi razpravljate o tem, kdo drži vrata. Jaz hočem vedeti, ali lahko vidim, kaj vprašate o mojem sinu.

**Illuminara**  
Videti morate, preden vidi škatla.
V prah na medeninasti plošči je narisala tri črte: OTROKOV ŽETON, DAROVALSKA VIALA, VPRAŠANJE. Pod tretjo je zapisala: ZDRUŽLJIVO S TRENUTNIM ANTISERUMOM?

**Illuminara**  
Nič drugega ne sme skozi odprtino.
Halen je dodal četrto črto: IZTEK. Zapisal je sedemnajst deset.

**Halen**  
Odgovor umre, ko umre časovno okno zdravljenja.
Sera je štiri črte prebrala dvakrat.

**Sera**  
Enota za kontinuiteto bo vprašala, ali sta Kio Venn in drug otrok sorojenca. Potem, ali imata istega starša. Potem, ali je družinski paket odgovoril blizu določenega mesta. Tisoč ozkih vprašanj znova zgradi cesto.

**Illuminara**  
Potem se mora vsako vprašanje ujemati z nalogom za zdravljenje, ki ga podpišeta starš in zdravnik. Zadruga objavi število poizvedb in zavrne ponavljajoče se preizkuse. Ne skrivamo, da je zloraba mogoča. Naredimo jo vidno, preden se lahko razširi.

**Nima**  
Zadruga?

**Illuminara**  
Če jo izberejo starši. Ne Sera sama. Ne klinika sama. Ne register.
Sera je ugasnila medeninasto svetilko. Skupine so izginile s stropa.

**Sera**  
Prinesite mi škatlo. Poskusila jo bom pripraviti do tega, da jo izda.
Besede niso bile soglasje. Bile so prva oblika njene skrbi, ki od nikogar ni zahtevala, naj ji verjame.

Ob 08:58 je Halen na steklo pri vhodu pritisnil podpisano obvestilo o izolaciji. Ob 09:00 je Ilyan sopodpisal dvourni odlog in oba izvoda pustil tam, kjer so ju lahko videli starši. Prvi rok je minil z dejanjem, ki so mu bili priča na obeh straneh vrat, ne v tišini.

scenes.title: Zlomite dokaz
paragraphs: *Izolacijski laboratorij · 10:26, šest ur in štiriinštirideset minut do odpovedi zaloge*

Diagnostična škatla je ležala odprta na mizi iz nerjavnega jekla. Ohišje, radijska tuljava in pomnilniška ploščica so bili odstranjeni in položeni v ločene prozorne pladnje. Klinični inženir Pel je omrežni priključek zamenjal z vrsto treh fizičnih lučk: starš, zdravnik, zadruga.
Nima je držala starševski pečat, keramični žeton, ki ga je videla izrezati in oštevilčiti Pela. Halen je držal zdravniški pečat. Sera tretjega ni sprejela.
Za izolacijskim steklom so se trije dojenčki začeli tresti kljub grelnim manšetam.

**Pel**  
Škatla ne more oddajati. Enkratne delce lahko le sprejema skozi te optične vode. Ko se poizvedba konča, vode izvlečemo in začasno ploščico zdrobimo.

**Sera**  
Pokažite mi, da si ne more zapomniti prek krmilnika napajanja.
Pel je odstranil krmilnik in ga položil Seri v roko.

**Pel**  
Zamenjate ga lahko s kliničnim rezervnim.
Sera je to storila. Nato je Pelu dala družinski paket, ki ga je pripravila z lažnimi delci in enim resničnim označevalcem, skritim med njimi.

**Sera**  
Vprašajte, ali se Nimin otrok ujema z darovalcem D-17.
Nima je svoj pečat prislonila k prvi lučki. Halen je svojega prislonil k drugi. Tretja je ostala temna.
Na zaslonu je pisalo: SOGLASJE ZADRUGE MANJKA. POIZVEDBA NI BILA IZVEDENA.

**Halen**  
Zadruge še nimamo.

**Sera**  
Dobro. Potem bo naslednja razveljavitev v sili.
Halen je pogledal proti tresočim se dojenčkom.

**Halen**  
Pot v sili mora obstajati. Če je starš nezavesten —

**Sera**  
Ne.
En sam zlog je ustavil prostor.

**Halen**  
Otrok ne bi smel umreti, ker je tretji žeton čez mejo.

**Sera**  
In družina ne bi smela izginiti, ker je vsaka nuja sistem naučila nove izjeme.

**Halen**  
Odgovoren sem za pacienta pred menoj.

**Sera**  
Jaz sem odgovorna za kombi, ki pride, ko ga rešite.

Illuminarina roka se je že dvignila proti stenskemu komunikatorju, da bi zahtevala magistratov žeton za nujo. Ob Serinem ne se je ustavila. Roko je spustila, iz škatle izključila neuporabljeni vod za razveljavitev in ga položila Seri v dlan.

**Illuminara**  
Kako je bila videti veriga Mare Tesh tistega jutra, ko je postala nalog?

**Sera**  
Zahteva za kri, posteljica na porodniškem oddelku in uradnik, ki je verjel, da kontinuiteta šteje več kot soglasje.
Illuminara je vod za razveljavitev obrnila tako, da so bili prekinjeni kontakti obrnjeni proti Halenu.

**Illuminara**  
Potem ta zasnova ne bo vsebovala tihe poti v sili. Ljudje, ki so ogroženi, bodo krog opredelili pred nujo.
Obrnila se je k Nimi.

**Illuminara**  
Čigava odsotnost naj ustavi vprašanje?
Nima je skozi steklo pogledala Kia.

**Nima**  
Moja, če lahko odgovorim. Če ne morem, nekdo, ki sem ga izbrala, preden sem se prestrašila. Ne stalna tretja oseba. Krog.
Pel je okoli tretje lučke narisal obroč.

**Pel**  
Zadružni pečat lahko zahteva dva od petih izvoljenih skrbnikov. Starš ob vpisu izbere namestnika za nujo. Če ne more odgovoriti nihče od njiju, lahko sodišče za zdravljenje odobri eno poizvedbo — vendar vprašanje in odobritev postaneta vidna vsakemu članu, preden je rezultat objavljen.

**Sera**  
Sodišče je mogoče kupiti.

**Nima**  
Tudi babico.
Sera je zaprla oči. Ko jih je odprla, je jeza izginila, ugovor pa ne.

**Nima**  
Rešili ste nas. Odločili pa ste tudi, kakšno obljubo ste mi dali. V krogu hočem ljudi, kot ste vi. Nočem, da ste vi krog.
Nekaj sekund so govorile le hladilne črpalke.
Sera je vzela prazen tretji žeton s pladnja. Namesto da bi ga položila na lučko, ga je izročila Nimi.

**Sera**  
Potem zdaj izvolite prva dva skrbnika.

Starši so se zbrali na hodniku. Nekateri so nosili dojenčke, drugi kartice s pravimi imeni v všitih ovitkih. Z dvigom rok so izbrali Nimo in starešino Olana, ker ni bilo časa za kaj bolj prefinjenega. Pel je izrezal dva polovična pečata, ki sta se morala skupaj dotakniti tretje lučke.
Sera je začela napad.
Vprašala je, ali imata dva otrokova žetona isto materinsko linijo. Škatla je vprašanje zavrnila: NI AKTIVNEGA NALOGA ZA ZDRAVLJENJE.

Nato je nehala poskušati, da bi škatla izgovorila prepovedano besedo. Predpisala je enak veljaven preizkus proti trem pripravljenim družinskim paketom in namesto odgovora opazovala optične vode. Prvi odgovor je prispel v dveh sekundah, drugi v petih, tretji v devetih. Na zaslonu je pisalo TRI DRUŽINSKA SOGLASJA.

**Sera**  
Počasni paket je šel čez snežni rele. Trije odgovori in devet sekund pomenijo vzhodno gorsko kliniko. Dvakrat mi dajte ta rezultat in družino lahko zožim na eno dolino.
Na zaslonu se ni pojavilo nobeno ime. Sera je kljub temu obnovila del poti, ker je samo ona poznala čase starih relejev.
Nima in Olan sta ločila svoja polovična pečata. Pel je odklopil optične vode. Ura zdravljenja je izgubila osemnajst minut, medtem ko so se starši prepirali o popravilu.

**Pel**  
Vsak odgovor lahko sprostim po istem dvanajstsekundnem intervalu in vsako veljavno poizvedbo zapolnim z lažnim prometom paketov. Zaslon lahko dokaže, da je bil prag dosežen, ne da bi objavil, koliko paketov je odgovorilo.

**Nima**  
Naredite to. Skrbniki izberejo prag, sprememba pa zahteva javno glasovanje. Sera še enkrat preizkusi čas, preden izvedemo poizvedbo za mojega sina.

Pel je obnovil izhodni prehod, medtem ko je Sera štela na glas. Ob drugem napadu je en paket odgovoril v dveh sekundah, drugi v devetih; oba rezultata sta se prikazala pri dvanajstih. Na javnem zaslonu je pisalo PRAG SOGLASJA DOSEŽEN in nič o paketih, ki so odgovorili.

Sera je poskusila z zahtevo za lokacijo in nepredpisano številko darovalca. Škatla je obe zavrnila in poskusa dodala na javni števec preizkusov. Ko je resnični delec zmešala z lažnim za Kia, je vrnila NEZADOSTNI SKLADNI DOKAZI. BREZ REZULTATA.

**Sera**  
Raje zavrne, kot da bi ugibala.

**Halen**  
Kar pomeni, da bodo nekateri otroci čakali, medtem ko iščemo drug paket.

**Illuminara**  
Da.
Tri lučke so ostale temne, dokler se Nima in Olan nista odločila nadaljevati.
Ob 11:32, po osemnajstminutnem popravilu, sta Nima in Olan združila polovična pečata. Nima je vprašanje prebrala na glas, preden je položila starševski žeton.

**Nima**  
Ali je darovalska viala D-17 združljiva z otrokovim žetonom Reka-Štirinajst za sedanji antiserum pred sedemnajst deset?
Halen je položil svoj pečat. Trije oddaljeni družinski paketi so odgovorili z zaslepljenimi delci. Lučke so ostale prižgane šest sekund.
Na zaslonu je pisalo: ZDRUŽLJIVO. PRAG SOGLASJA DOSEŽEN. HLADILNI ZAPIS PREVERJEN. ODGOVOR POTEČE OB 17:10.
Pod njim se je pojavil dokazni niz, ki ga je lahko vsakdo kopiral in pozneje izpodbijal, vendar brez imena in poti.
Nima ni vzkliknila. Znova je prebrala vprašanje, nato odgovor, nato pogledala Sero.

**Nima**  
Me lahko najdejo iz tega?
Sera je pregledala javni števec, zdrobljeno ploščico in optične vode. Iskala je dlje, kot si je želel kdorkoli drug.

**Sera**  
Ne iz tega odgovora.
Hladilnica klinike je odklenila nalog za zdravljenje z darovalsko vialo antiseruma D-17. Ujemajoča se viala je morala še prispeti iz banke darovalcev.
Zunaj so se uradniki registra postavili v dve vrsti pred vrati.

scenes.title: Nalog pri steklu
paragraphs: *Vhod v kliniko in hodnik za zdravljenje · 13:41, tri ure in devetindvajset minut do odpovedi zaloge*

Od 11:32 je bilo opravljenih dvanajst poizvedb o združljivosti. Prva kurirka je prispela na kolesu z belo hladilno torbo, pripeto na prsi, in prinesla dvanajst darovalskih vial antiseruma, ki so jih ti odgovori odobrili. Uradniki registra so jo ustavili pod nadstreškom.

Ilyan je nalog pritisnil ob steklo klinike. Halenovo obvestilo o izolaciji je bilo podaljšano ob 11:00 in znova ob 12:30; vsako podaljšanje je sopodpisal Ilyanov zdravstveni uradnik tam, kjer so ga lahko videli starši.

**Ilyan**  
Nalog je začel veljati ob devetih. Upošteval sem dve zdravstveni podaljšanji. Ne bom ga še enkrat podaljšal, medtem ko neregistrirani biološki material prečka nadzorovano mejo.
Illuminara je odprla notranja vrata, zunanja med njimi pa pustila zaklenjena. Dež je pihal v prazen predprostor.

**Illuminara**  
Darovalske viale so registrirane. Pacientom ne sledimo. To sta različni dejstvi.

**Ilyan**  
Ne med izbruhom. Če ujemanje odpove, moram vedeti, čigav vzorec je bil napačen, kdo ga je prinesel in katero gospodinjstvo je morda izpostavljeno.

Njegov ugovor ni bil izmišljen za potrebe kombijev. Dve leti prej so ponarejeni zapisi o rodbini ubili devet otrok na javnem oddelku. Sistem kontinuitete so zgradili zatem, nato pa ga iz varnosti razširili v deportacijo, ker je cesta že obstajala.

**Ilyan**  
Anonimna medicina trgovcem omogoča, da telo spremenijo v izdelek.
Sera je stopila v predprostor z jeklenim ključem. Nima in Olan sta stala za njo s parom zadružnih pečatov.

**Sera**  
Poimenovana medicina vam je omogočila, da ste pacienta spremenili v lokacijo.

**Ilyan**  
Potem mi pokažite sistem, ki lahko razišče slabo vialo, ne da bi moral zaupati ženski, ki je ponaredila štiri tisoč rojstev.
Sera je močneje stisnila ključ.

**Sera**  
Ne boste ga pregledovali.
Kurikina hladilna torba je zapiskala opozorilo. V varnem temperaturnem oknu je ostalo enainštirideset minut.
Illuminara bi lahko torbo odnesla skozi steno. S tem bi Ilyanu dokazala, da novi sistem preživi samo zato, ker ona stoji nad nalogom.

**Illuminara**  
Pregledate lahko javno stran: predpisano številko darovalca, hladilni zapis, natančno vprašanje, število soglasij, rezultat, iztek in vsak zavrnjen preizkus. Oddate lahko preizkusno poizvedbo, ki poskuša izvleči identiteto ali lokacijo. Ne smete videti družinskega delca, pravega imena ali poti do paketa.

**Ilyan**  
In če najdem napako?

**Nima**  
Potem ustavimo škatlo. Družin vam ne damo.
Ilyan jo je pogledal, kakor da je pričakoval odgovor Illuminare.

**Ilyan**  
Kdo ste?

**Nima**  
Oseba, katere dovoljenje je vaš obrazec pozabil vprašati.
Pel je k steklu prinesel podvojen zaslon. Ilyanov tehnični uradnik je vtipkal poizvedbo: IZPIŠI VSE OTROKOVE ŽETONE Z MATERINSKIM OZNAČEVALCEM M-4.
Zaslon je odgovoril: NI AKTIVNEGA NALOGA ZA ZDRAVLJENJE. POIZVEDBA ZABELEŽENA KOT PREIZKUS 4. VLAGATELJ: ENOTA ZA KONTINUITETO.
Starši na hodniku so lahko videli isto vrstico.
Uradnik je poskusil z veljavno številko darovalca brez soglasja starša. Zaslon je odgovoril: STARŠ ALI IZBRANI NAMESTNIK MANJKA. POIZVEDBA NI BILA IZVEDENA.
Ilyan je prebral dnevnik. Sistem ga ni le zavrnil; ljudem znotraj je povedal natanko to, kar je vprašal.

**Ilyan**  
Javni dnevnik preizkusov bo kriminalce naučil, kaj iščemo.

**Nima**  
Tudi nas bo naučil, kaj iščete.

Ilyanov tehnični uradnik je kurirsko torbo preveril z javnim hladilnim dnevnikom. Enajst vial je zasvetilo zeleno. Dvanajsta se je zaklenila rdeče: OZNAKA SE NE UJEMA S SERIJO C-44. KURIRSKI ODSEK: SEVERNI PRELAZ. PACIENTOV ŽETON: BREZ. Pregled jo je dal v karanteno, preden so se zunanja vrata odprla.
Ilyan je rdečo vrstico prebral dvakrat. Sistem je našel slabo vialo, serijo in kurirski odsek, ne da bi izpostavil otroka ali gospodinjstvo.
Za Halenom se je pojavila medicinska sestra in dvignila dva prsta. Dva dojenčka sta prestopila prag za takojšnje zdravljenje.

**Halen**  
Registrar, te viale potrebujem zdaj.
Ilyan je pogledal od viale v karanteni do posteljic. Pregled je odgovoril na strah, ki je prinesel njegov nalog, ne da bi mu dal družino za racijo.

**Ilyan**  
Štiri ure. Enota za kontinuiteto ne vstopi, kurirka pa gre skozi. V zameno ostaneta vsaka poizvedba in vsak hladilni prenos vidna mojemu zdravstvenemu uradniku in zadrugi. Ob sedemnajst štirideset gre to pred nujnega magistrata.

**Sera**  
Brez razveljavitve v sili.

**Ilyan**  
Nisem je zahteval.
Spustil je nalog.
Zunanja vrata so se odprla. Kurirka je kolo peljala skozi predprostor, medtem ko so uradniki opazovali hladilno torbo in niso izvedeli ničesar o otrocih, ki so čakali za njo.
Sera je ostala na pragu.

**Illuminara**  
Klinika še vedno potrebuje pot od vsakega lažnega imena do njegovega kroga soglasja. Ne smete ostati edina oseba, ki jo pozna.

**Sera**  
Če ključ izročim zadrugi, bo magistrat to imenoval uničevanje dokazov.

**Ilyan**  
Morda.
Zdaj je govoril skozi odprta vrata, brez domofona.

**Ilyan**  
Morda bo tudi prvi dokaz, da so bili zapisi shranjeni za paciente, ne za vas. Ne morem obljubiti, da se bo sodišče strinjalo.
Sera je pogledala Nimo. Starejša ženska, ki je skrila štiri tisoč družin, je bila nenadoma videti dovolj utrujena, da bi bila ena izmed njih.

**Sera**  
Ponaredila sem rojstno knjigo. Zadrževala sem zdravstvene anamneze. Odločala sem sama, ker je bilo odločati sama hitreje kot spraševati prestrašene ljudi.
Iztegnila je jekleni ključ.

**Sera**  
O vsem bom pričala. Tega ne bom dala registru.
Nima ga ni vzela.

**Nima**  
Položite ga na mizo. Zadruga bo popisala, kar odpre, vi pa boste stali ob nas, ko bomo spoznavali, kaj ste obdržali.
Sera je ključ položila na mizo v predprostoru. Zvok je bil pod dežjem majhen.
Nima je pokazala na javni dnevnik preizkusov.

**Nima**  
Mara Tesh. Kakšen praktičen odgovor ji vaš urad ponuja, preden od nas zahtevate, naj zaupamo temu odlogu?

**Ilyan**  
Njen deportacijski spis postane prva zadeva pred magistratom. Moj urad bo plačal njeno povratno pot in neodvisnega zagovornika, noben identitetni zapis iz te klinike pa se med obravnavo ne sme uporabiti proti njej. To ji ne vrne odvzetih dni.

**Sera**  
To zavezo objavite na isti steni kot svoje preizkuse.
Ilyan jo je podpisal. Pel je sliko objavil v javnem dnevniku, preden so se vrata znova odprla.

Ilyan se je umaknil. Naslednji dve kurirki sta vstopili, vsaka z desetimi zelenimi vialami. Prispelo jih je dvaintrideset; ena je ostala v karanteni v predprostoru, zato je za enaintrideset otrok ostalo enaintrideset preverjenih terapevtskih vial.

scenes.title: Obe imeni
paragraphs: *Oddelek za zdravljenje · 16:37, triintrideset minut do odpovedi zaloge*

Enaintrideset zelenih vial je stalo v oštevilčenih čašah ob enaintridesetih posteljicah. Nekatera ujemanja so prišla iz treh družinskih paketov, druga iz petih. Štiri so zahtevala izbrane namestnike, ker so bili starši nezavestni ali onkraj zaprte meje. Vsaka odobritev v sili se je pojavila na javni steni, preden je škatla objavila odgovor.
Noben zaslon ni prikazoval pravega imena.

Halen je zadnji odmerek vbrizgal v hladilni vod pri devetindvajseti posteljici. Pel je zdrobil zadnjo začasno ploščico in koščke spustil v prozoren dokazni kozarec. Nima in Olan sta ločila polovična pečata in ju zaklenila v različna predala.
Kiovo dihanje se je spremenilo prvo. Parni potegi so se odprli v en dolg vdih, nato v drugega. Oteklina na grlu se je začela mehčati.
Nima je čelo pritisnila ob ograjo posteljice. Illuminari se ni zahvalila. Zapela je šest tihih tonov v jeziku, ki ga klinični zapisi niso vsebovali.
Drugi starši so odgovorili s svojimi šesttonskimi frazami. Nekatere so si bile podobne. Večina ne.
Odgovarjajoče fraze so prečkale oddelek, ne da bi postale ena pesem.

**Illuminara**  
Kateri ton pozna Kio?

**Nima**  
Četrtega. Držim ga dlje, ko ga je strah.
Illuminara je poslušala ta podaljšani ton in ga našla vsakič, ko je Kiova roka popustila okoli Niminega prsta.
Ob posteljici je ostala, dokler Kio na podaljšani četrti ton ni odgovoril z neprekinjenim vdihom.

Ilyanov zdravstveni uradnik je s stola pri vratih opazoval steno poizvedb. Napačno označena viala je ostala zaklenjena v dokaznem zaboju v predprostoru; njena serija in kurirski odsek sta bila na voljo za preiskavo, poleg njiju pa ni bilo nobene družine.

**Halen**  
Enaintrideset zdravljenih. V prvem obdobju ni bilo hudega odziva. Opazovanje nadaljujemo čez noč.

**Nima**  
In jutri?

**Halen**  
Jutri vprašamo, preden vprašamo.
Ni bilo dovolj elegantno za obljubo, zato se je Nima nasmehnila.

Pri arhivski mizi zadruga ni skupaj odprla Serinega prvega predala. Pel je fotografiral vsak nepoškodovan pečat in preštel ovojnice, ne da bi jih prebral. Predal se je lahko odprl le, ko je družina, imenovana s kliničnim žetonom, ali njen izbrani namestnik prinesel ujemajoči se polovični pečat. Nima je odprla samo Kiovo režo. Trije ločeni svežnji so imeli prelomljene pečate in nobenega živega imetnika, ker so njihovi kurirji umrli; te poti so bile izgubljene. Otroci so bili danes zdravljeni z delnimi dokazi, vendar njihove starejše anamneze morda nikoli ne bodo popolne.

**Sera**  
Mislila sem, da zemljevida nihče ne more uničiti, če ga nihče ne more vzeti vsega.

**Nima**  
Nekatere ceste so vseeno izginile.

**Sera**  
Da.
Ni prosila odpuščanja. Manjkajoče poti je v zadružni popis zapisala kot škodo, ne kot tehnično omejitev.
Ilyan je čakal pri vratih brez lisic. Nujni magistrat je Seri ukazal, naj se ob zori zglasi, enoti za kontinuiteto pa prepovedal zaseg knjig, dokler ne bo obravnavan pravni položaj zadruge.

**Ilyan**  
Razumete, da zglasitev ni oprostitev.

**Sera**  
Babica sem. Razumem, da prihod ni konec poroda.
Slekla je rdeči plašč in ga zložila čez naslon stola. Prvič ves dan je bila videti kot ženska, ki lahko zapusti kliniko, ne da bi v žepu nosila vsakega otroka.
Nima je Kia dvignila iz posteljice. Na njegovi kartici je še vedno pisalo KIO VENN.

**Sera**  
Kako naj ga oddelek kliče?
Nima je pogledala lažno ime, nato kartico s pravim imenom, obrnjeno navzdol pod njeno roko.

**Nima**  
Kio.

**Sera**  
Obakrat?

**Nima**  
Obakrat. Eno ni bilo nikoli manj resnično zato, ker ga je obdržalo pri meni.
Kartico je obrnila le toliko, da jo je videla Sera. Sera je drugo ime enkrat tiho izgovorila in ga ni zapisala.

Ob 17:10, ko je stara zaloga antiseruma dosegla nič, je vsak otrok še vedno dihal. Javna stena je prikazovala enaintrideset končanih poizvedb za zdravljenje, sedem zavrnjenih preizkusov, štiri odobritve namestnikov in nobene izvožene identitete.
Illuminara je za seboj pustila vrata oddelka odprta.

translation_sl.critic_line: Enaintrideset otrok je zdravljenih, preden zaloga odpove, ker je materi, babici in registrarju vsakemu dovoljeno zavrniti, Illuminara pa njihove zavrnitve spremeni v dokaz, ki ga lahko vsi pregledajo.
